context:
Goal: q_max merges cost fewer runner minutes.
Problem (cost): each merge to main re-runs the full suite on a tree its batch PR run already proved, about 94 runner-min and 15 min per merge (runner 11 audit). q_max D-695 and D-537 say full CI on main, so skipping needs your word.
Based on (ruling): claude-settings ci-once-per-batch (your 21:16 CST Nov 12), which skipped the same repeat run at home.
Departs from: q_max main, which runs the full suite on every push — a skips it when the batch PR run proved the same tree.

options.gain: About 94 runner-min and 15 min saved per merge.
options.how: q_max skips the push-to-main suite on a tree its batch PR run proved.
options.label: Skip it, like home (recommended)
options.lose: A tree changed after the batch run gets no second full run on main.

options.gain: Main is proven by its own run.
options.how: q_max keeps D-695 and D-537 as they are.
options.label: Keep full CI on main
options.lose: About 94 runner-min and 15 min spent per merge.

ref: coordinator 11:48 CST Nov 13, runner 11 child-repo CI audit
title: In q_max, skip the full suite on push to main when the batch PR run already proved the same tree?
why: Overturns q_max records D-695 and D-537, which need your word.
